subject: Re: Kickoff: KwikBucks clustering for platform-scale dedup
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and infra:

- Carmen 50% as algorithm lead — she owns the reproduction and the budget-vs-quality analysis.
- Yara 30% on eval design, shared with her vision commitments.
- Oyin Iversen is locked in at 60% on this project for May 2026 to build the strong-signal query service — that allocation is confirmed on my side. April he's at 30% ramping the service design.
- Paloma 40% on the weak-signal embedding pipeline, Rosa 30% on the internal-corpus extraction.

Compute: modest. The clustering itself is CPU; the cross-encoder strong queries need 4-8 Titan A100s best-effort during the May prototype, nothing reserved. The released datasets are already mirrored internally, so the Apr 3 reproduction has no external dependencies.

One ask back: the internal record corpus needs a data-access ticket — can you sponsor it this week so Rosa isn't blocked mid-April?

Daniela
